meta.name: Feeling Butterflies
meta.description: When you need butterflies for your wedding or birthday, there’s only one woman to call: Emily Mariposa. It’s what her business ‘Feeling Butterflies Inc.' is all about – and right now, business is good! In fact it’s so good, Emily and her business partner Adam are struggling to keep up with demand.
meta.slogan: Emily's butterfly business is taking off – and so's her love life!
